metadata.title: Mamiratra | Helping local talent shine
metadata.description: Mamiratra helps small entrepreneurs and local talent gain visibility with accessible professional photos, videos and digital content.

hero.title: Helping those who deserve to be seen shine.
hero.description: Mamiratra helps small entrepreneurs, creators and local talents gain visibility through simple, professional and accessible content.
hero.imageAlt: An artisan’s hands shaping clay on a pottery wheel
hero.imageCaption: Let’s bring it into the light.

mission.title: Bringing visibility to those who deserve to be seen.
mission.description: Mamiratra supports small entrepreneurs and local talent with real skills who sometimes lack the visibility, time or resources to communicate effectively.
mission.statement: The talent is already there. We simply help others discover it.
